echoParts: Though your sins are like scarlet
they will be as white as snow
though they are as red as crimson
verseText: Though your sins are like scarlet, they will be as white as snow; though they are as red as crimson, they will become like wool.
meaning: The price of sin is deep and serious: forever death! But even the filthiest sinner can be washed clean through Jesus' blood.

recall.question: Scarlet and crimson are shades of red. What does God say our sins can become like?

meaning.question: God uses the picture of making something stained white as snow. What does this teach us about Him?
choices: He can wash away our sins
He wants us to wash away our own sins

application.prompt: Have you ever gotten a stain on your clothes that seemed impossible to wash out? Sin is like a stain we can't wash away ourselves. But Jesus can make us clean! No matter what you've done wrong, you can come to Him and ask for forgiveness.
